subject: note: if God is all-loving, then should not such love extend to permitting the suicide of one of his creatures when their suffering has become too hard to bear? How could an all-loving God demand the continuation of intolerable suffering?
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
